commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' The attendance is 37008.
90+5' Marcao (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.

86' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) fails to deliver a decent free kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
85' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Victor Garcia and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

77' 1 - 3 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Mateo Joseph (Mallorca), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:3.
75' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
72' 1 - 2 Goal! Johan Mojica shows great vision to find Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the middle of the goal. 1:2.
71' Matias Almeyda decides to make a substitution. Isaac Romero will be replaced by Akor Adams (Sevilla).
71' Here is a change. Djibril Sow is going off and Matias Almeyda gives the last tactical orders to Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juanlu Sanchez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla).
67' 1 - 1 Goal! Jan Virgili plays a simple square pass into the feet of Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:1.

61' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
59' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
58' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

57' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sevilla.
55' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
51' Samu Costa (Mallorca) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
50' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) takes the corner but it's cleared.
50' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
47' Victor Garcia interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca).

46' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Odysseas Vlachodimos guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
42' Victor Garcia has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ramon Martinez (Sevilla).
41' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

39' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his low strike to the middle of the target as Odysseas Vlachodimos produces a good save.
36' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
32' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
30' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
29' It looks like Javier Llabres (Mallorca) saw red with that tackle. Victor Garcia won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
29' The ball is cleared after Javier Llabres (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

28' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities. Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 58:42.
26' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

26' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the roof of the net, but great anticipation by Odysseas Vlachodimos allowed him to make a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mallorca.
25' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

24' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
23' The game is interrupted. Batista Mendy (Sevilla) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
19' Dangerous play by Jan Virgili (Mallorca). Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.

16' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) scores with a brilliant shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Jose Angel Carmona. The score is now 1:0.
15' The total number of attempts is 0:0.
12' Rough tackle by Marcao (Sevilla). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Mallorca control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
7' The foul by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) was seen by Victor Garcia who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
5' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
3' Matias Almeyda is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Cesar Azpilicueta suffers an injury and Ramon Martinez (Sevilla) comes on.
2' Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
